verdict.rationale: Orama's docs show a short path: install via npm/yarn/pnpm/bun, create a database with an indexing schema, and insert documents, which the docs call 'quick and intuitive'. The search docs cover full-text, vector and hybrid queries, so the create-insert-search flow is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit quickstart showing the first search call end to end, any evidence for the 'within minutes' time-to-first-search claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience.
